title: College Football
description:
Northwestern at Ohio State
The No. 20 Ohio State Buckeyes (6-3, 4-2 Big Ten) host the Northwestern Wildcats (6-3, 3-3 Big Ten) at Ohio Stadium. Both teams aim to break a two-game skid. Northwestern relies on Aidan Chiles, while Ohio State looks to Julian Sayin.

title: College Football
description:
Baylor at BYU
The No. 10 BYU Cougars (7-2) host the Baylor Bears (6-3) at LaVell Edwards Stadium in Provo for a Big 12 matchup. Baylor enters on a two-game win streak and beat Iowa State 42-31 in Week 10, while BYU fell 28-20 to Utah and relies on Bear Bachmeier.

title: College Football
description:
Utah at Arizona
The No. 2 Utes (9-0, 6-0 Big 12) seek their first 10-0 start since 2008 as they visit the No. 23 Wildcats (7-2, 4-2). Utah comes off a 28-20 triumph over rival BYU. Arizona has won seven straight at home following a 29-28 victory over TCU last week.
